charts.question: Anticipating first-attempt correctness
charts.supported_finding: Author predictions come from the published learner-fold analysis; the new fit imposes an additional historical cutoff.
charts.interpretation_boundary: The public CSEDM example describes a subset of the 89-learner, 38-task source cohort. It contains aggregated learner/problem outcomes. Actual code examples are from the independent Refactory study. No newly delivered hint or transfer improvement is attributed to either cohort.
